newsitem.title: CANADA: SNC-Lavalin to issue 4.4 mln class A shrs.
newsitem.headline: SNC-Lavalin to issue 4.4 mln class A shrs.

text.p: SNC-Lavalin Group Inc said on Monday it signed a deal with a group of underwriters to issue 4.4 million class A subordinate voting shares to the public at C$16.55 per share.
The C$69.9 million net proceeds will be used for corporate purposes including the funding of possible future acquisitions and investment opportunities in both Canada and abroad.
The underwriting group consists of Newcrest Capital Inc, RBC Dominion Securities Inc, Gordon Capital Corp, ScotiaMcLeod Inc, Levesque Beaubien, CIBC Wood Gundy Inc and Trilon Securities Corp.

The issue will represent less than nine percent of the outstanding share capital of the company. The class A subordinate voting shares of SNC-Lavalin closed on Friday at C$16.35 on the Montreal Exchange and C$16.40 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
